heading: INT. CAR IMPOUND LOT - OFFICE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. CAR IMPOUND LOT - OFFICE - NIGHT
A prefab shed with a buzzing light and a bulletproof window.
Wall of keys on numbered hooks.
A space heater ticks.
Beyond the glass, rows of towed cars shine like sleeping animals under floodlights.
IMELDA ROQUE (50s, night clerk, cardigan, reading glasses, a paperback face-down on the desk) sits at a counter, eating crackers one at a time.
DOBBS (30s, tow driver, grease on his sleeves) sprawls in the visitor's chair, sipping a soda, tapping his boot.
The radio on the desk crackles with a disembodied voice.
Unit twelve, pickup at Fifth and Mercer, black sedan, plates blocked. Over.
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: Copy.
units.name: DOBBS

units.text: Dobbs, you're on break.
units.name: IMELDA

units.text: Dispatch doesn't know that.
units.name: DOBBS

units.text: The glass door chimes.
A MAN (40s, wet trench coat, hat low, hands deep in his pockets) steps in, shaking rain off his shoulders.
He takes in the room, the counter, the wall of keys, the clerk, the driver.
His eyes settle on the keys.
Evening. I'm here for a car.
units.name: MAN

units.text: License and registration.
units.name: IMELDA

units.text: It's not mine. It's a friend's.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Then your friend can come get it.
units.name: IMELDA

units.text: My friend's indisposed.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Dobbs puts down his soda.
The Man lifts one hand from his pocket, slowly, and lays a thick envelope on the counter.
Imelda doesn't touch it.
The Man produces a driver's license and slides it across.
She picks it up, tilts it toward the lamp, reads.
Mr. Rafferty. Francis Rafferty.
units.name: IMELDA

units.text: Frank.
units.name: RAFFERTY

units.text: Mr. Rafferty. This says Ohio.
units.name: IMELDA

units.text: Ohio is where I'm from.
units.name: RAFFERTY

units.text: The car is Illinois.
units.name: IMELDA

units.text: It's a very long drive.
units.name: RAFFERTY

units.text: Dobbs stands, stretching, and drifts toward the door.
Imelda watches him go.
She hands the license back and takes the envelope in the same motion, slides it into a drawer, closes the drawer with her knee.
Rafferty smiles faintly.
Space nine. Black Chrysler. I'll need you to sign.
units.name: IMELDA

units.text: Of course.
units.name: RAFFERTY

units.text: She slides a form across.
Rafferty bends to sign.
Dobbs, by the door, puts a hand on the knob and stops.
Through the glass, the floodlights flicker once, and all down the long rows of impounded cars, a headlight comes on.
Then another.
Then ten.
Unit twelve, disregard the pickup. All units, return to the lot immediately. I repeat, return to the lot.
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: Dobbs snatches the radio.
Imelda lifts her glasses onto her forehead.
Rafferty finishes his signature, caps the pen, and sets it down on the form with great care.
Dispatch, what's going on?
units.name: DOBBS

units.text: Dobbs, don't let the man leave.
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: Mr. Dobbs, I'd like to leave now.
units.name: RAFFERTY

units.text: You'd better sit.
units.name: IMELDA

units.text: I'm afraid I can't.
units.name: RAFFERTY

units.text: Outside, one by one, the engines catch.
A low thunder rises across the lot.
Rafferty looks over his shoulder at the glass, then at Imelda, then at the keys on the wall that are, one by one, beginning to swing.
They always do this when I come for one.
units.name: RAFFERTY

units.text: He tips his hat.
The door chimes open on its own.
Rafferty walks out into the glare of a hundred headlights, and the engines fall silent as he passes.
